CREATE TABLE memory_situation_result_bindings (
	receipt_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	validation_revision VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	rules_revision VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	recheck_run_id VARCHAR(64), 
	proof JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (receipt_sequence, validation_revision, rules_revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recheck_run_id) REFERENCES memory_situation_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_sequence) REFERENCES memory_situation_receipts (sequence) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
